description: Add a note (annotation) to a Dynamics 365 account, contact, lead or opportunity — e.g. the gist of a call or e-mail. Required: regarding_entity, regarding_id, text. Optional: subject. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

regarding_entity.description: Entity type of the record the note is attached to

name: create_dynamics_note
